items.description: Crowne Plaza® Monterrey, your meeting point in the heart of the city ¡We are ready to welcome you! Located on Av. Constitución, just steps from the Historic Center and the Pabellón M Convention Center, with access to cinemas, restaurants, and shows. Nearby you will find the main tourist attractions: Paseo Santa Lucía, Parque Fundidora, Zona Splash, Macroplaza, and museums. In addition, we are less than 10 minutes from Arena Monterrey and Auditorio Banamex, and 25 minutes from the airport. The largest hotel in the north of the country, with 403 rooms and 14 event rooms for up to 1,200 people, we offer banquet, catering, and dining services in our Las Ventanas restaurant, famous for its themed buffet: Italian, Mexican, and grill. Comfort and entertainment without leaving the hotel, Lobby Bar, Executive Floor with breakfast and canapés, heated indoor pool with jacuzzi, tennis and basketball courts, gym, billiards and sauna. Everything you need for a complete stay.

items.description: We warmly welcome you to Holiday Inn® Monterrey Valle . We are located in San Pedro Garza García next to Trébol Park , and between the Los Soles and Torre Alestra buildings. The hotel is surrounded by companies such as DeAcero, Cemex, Vitro, Johnson Controls, Gruma, Banorte , and corporate buildings such as Torre KOI, Metropolitan Center, Torre ING, Distrito Armida and Torre Avalanz . We have the IHG Rewards Club loyalty program and the IHG Clean Promise cleaning protocols. Relax in our Bar and on the garden terrace where you can enjoy your food and the outdoor pool We are a few minutes from the main shopping malls Fashion Drive, Valle Oriente and Paseo San Pedro . We invite you to our Los Alcatraces fusion food restaurant , which also offers Room Service . The hotel is perfect for any type of trip since in our spacious meeting rooms you can organize your most important social events such as weddings, bachelorette parties and birthdays . Just a few minutes away are the Hospital Zambrano and Hospital Ángeles Valle Oriente and the new show center Show Center , and close from arenas such as Arena Monterrey & Palco Tecate . Our staff is committed to providing you with the best service and attention so that your visit to Monterrey, Nuevo León is extraordinary!

items.description: We give you the warmest welcome to Hotel Holiday Inn Express Monterrey Fundidora, with a privileged location, in front of one of Monterrey's tourist icons: Fundidora Park, where you can enjoy the majestic landscape, Paseo Santa Lucía, Aquamundo, Fundidora Icerink, Muscera, Centro de las Artes, Cineteca Nuevo León, Amazonia among many other attractions. You can also enjoy the best events and music festivals and you can have pedestrian access to the venues of Cintermex, Arena Monterrey, Citibanamex Auditorium. Work out in our gym, work from our Business Center with our high-speed wireless Internet and enjoy the comfort of our rooms.

items.name: Monterrey-Parque Fundidora
items.parking_description: Outdoor & indoor free parking at Hotel for guests, open 24 hours.
items.description: Stay at Holiday Inn Parque Fundidora and experience international energy in Monterrey, just 15 minutes from Monterrey Stadium. The Holiday Inn Monterrey Parque Fundidora, get ready for the ultimate sports celebration, really does have a prime location nestled right inside Fundidora Park, which means you're steps away from top venues like Arena Monterrey, Auditorio Banamex, and Cintermex, all accessible via a private air-conditioned tunnel. Paseo Santa Lucía is a must whether you stroll along the riverwalk or hop on a boat. It’s a scenic way to soak in the city’s charm. And while Fundidora Splash Zone has closed as a theme park, the area is being transformed into a vibrant public space with green areas and free attractions. For culture lovers, nearby museums like MARCO - Museo de Arte Contemporáneo, MUNE - Museo del Noreste, and the Museo de Historia Mexicana offer rich insights into Mexican and regional history and art. When the sun sets, Barrio Antiguo comes alive with its bohemian vibe, historic architecture, and buzzing nightlife. And don’t miss Restaurante El Crisol at the hotel. It serves international cuisine throughout the day and offers a relaxing view of the park.

items.description: It is a pleasure to welcome you to the Holiday Inn Express & Suites Monterrey Valle . Located in the financial center of San Pedro Garza Garcia , the hotel is a close neighbor to many companies, offering easy access to Cemex , Vitro , Gruma , Sigma Alimentos , Banorte , BBVA , and Santander . Corporate rate programs are available to many companies that are eligible to earn IHG Rewards Club points. A 24-hour Business Center is available for your convenience. We are located near the exclusive shopping centers of the area such as Fashion Drive and Plaza Fiesta San Agustin . Our team is fully committed to offer a wide range of services to make our guests experience truly enjoyable. Our friendly staff is pleased to serve and offer recommendations on superb restaurants, lounges, nightlife activities, upscale galleries, and shops - all within walking distance of the hotel. Start your day with the complimentary Express Start breakfast . Take advantage of our fully equipped Fitness Center from 06:00 to 23:00 hr. Enjoy our complimentary wireless high-speed Internet while relaxing on the outdoor patio. We want you to enjoy every day of your stay, so we commit to offer the best service.

items.description: Experience the most exciting football season and stay at Holiday Inn Express® Monterrey Tecnológico, just 15 minutes from Monterrey Stadium. Our prime location on Eugenio Garza Sada Avenue connects you to the best of Monterrey. We are steps away from the prestigious ITESM (Tecnológico de Monterrey) and close to major companies such as Ternium, FEMSA, Xignux, and DeAcero, making us the ideal choice for business trips and academic stays. For leisure, enjoy easy access to Arena Monterrey, Cintermex, Monterrey Stadium, and shopping centers like Paseo Tec and Garza Sada 1892. Within minutes, you’ll discover a wide range of dining options: fresh seafood, Argentinian steaks, Brazilian rodizio, healthy choices, casual dining, and gourmet burgers.

items.description: We are Ready to assist you! Western Financial and Commercial Area Hotel The Holiday Inn Express® Monterrey Galerías-San Jerónimo Hotel is conveniently located on San Jerónimo Avenue, in the heart of the western financial and commercial area of Monterrey and less than ten minutes away from the Valle corporate zone. We are also convenient to downtown Monterrey and the Industrial part of Santa Catarina. In your leisure time, enjoy a variety of specialty cuisine restaurants around the hotel, go shopping at Plaza Galerías Monterrey, or visit Bishopric Hill and enjoy an unobstructed panoramic view of the city. Our goal at this Holiday Inn Express Hotel is to make your stay as delightful as possible while helping you efficiently fulfill your commitments. For that reason, we offer a 24-hour Business Center where you can comfortably keep up with work, a Fitness Center for you to stay active, and an outdoor pool to wind down after a busy day. Additionally, we offer Internet access, an everyday breakfast buffet and local calls as complimentary services.

items.description: Award-Winning San Pedro Extended Stay Hotel Encounter a peaceful home-like atmosphere at the Staybridge Suites® Monterrey-San Pedro Hotel. With suites and flexible accommodations, we are the best choice for weekend travels, corporate relocations or extended business projects in the lively growing metropolis of Monterrey. Located in San Pedro's Valle Area, you will be less than ten minutes away from corporate buildings like IOS Offices and companies such as General Electric, Hewlett Packard, Arca Continental, British American Tobacco, Cemex and Alfa. During your leisure time, hike Chipinque Ecological Park and admire the city, or shop at high-end boutiques all through Calzada del Valle. At night, go out and enjoy Centrito Valle's vibrant nightlife. Stay in touch with the office and home with complimentary high-speed internet access and rest in spacious, fully equipped suites . The fitness center helps you keep up your workout routine and the business center allows you to comfortably wrap your workday. Wind down in the cozy Great Room, have a cookout in our outdoor grills , enjoy the sun in the outdoor pool , and don’t miss The Social to get together with other guests while enjoying complimentary drinks and appetizers.

items.name: Monterrey Norte
items.address: Av. Universidad Norte # 101, Monterrey, NLE 66450, MX
items.description: The Best Hotel in the North Side of Monterrey Welcome to the city of mountains. Whatever the main purpose of your visit, the Holiday Inn® Monterrey Norte Hotel offers you the best location to complete your activities on the northern part of Monterrey. We are conveniently located on Universidad Avenue, which grants you easy access to UANL State University and companies such as Ternium, Femsa, International Truck and Navistar . Also, within a 10-minute drive, you will find Del Norte international Airport (ADN/MMAN) and Cintermex Convention Center. Enjoy local entertainment going to a soccer or baseball game at Estadio Universitario and Estadio de Béisbol Monterrey, shop at Plaza Fiesta Anáhuac or Plaza Centrika and take the subway at one of the several nearby stations and explore downtown or go clubbing at Barrio Antiguo. To further enhance your corporate experience, we offer you a modern Business Center and seven different on-site meeting rooms that accommodate up to 380 people. After a busy workday, unwind in our outdoor pool, challenge yourself with a tennis match on our court and keep up your workout routine at the Fitness Center. Enjoy a traditional ‘Norteño’ steak at Astro’s Restaurant and have drinks at Madam Garbo Lobby Bar.

items.description: Welcome to the Holiday Inn Express & Suites Monterrey Sendero. Our hotel in Escobedo is conveniently located near Plaza Sendero Escobedo, Museo Histórico Escobedo, and HappyLand Park Sendero. Enjoy simple, smart travel with our modern amenities, comfortable rooms, and great location. Start your day with a complimentary hot breakfast. Keep up your routine in our 24-hour fitness center and take advantage of our free Wi-Fi and on-site parking. After a day of exploring, settle into our spacious suites and rooms with cozy bedding, a mini fridge, and an in-room coffee maker. Whether you're here for work or play, we look forward to welcoming you to the hotel in Monterrey, Mexico.

items.description: Welcome to the new Holiday Inn & Suites Monterrey Apodaca Airport, the ideal choice for travelers seeking a convenient location, comfortable, clean rooms and a friendly service. Strategically located in Miguel Alemán Avenue, we are 10 minutes away from Monterrey International Airport (MTY) and we provide complimentary transportation service from 5am to 11pm with previous reservation require. We also are in the most important industrial parks such as Almacentro, Prologis Park, Kronos, Apodaca Technology Park, Monterrey Industrial Park, Kalos, Finsa and much more. We are located inside Nave01 Shopping mall, where apart from our delicious restaurant you can find a varied gastronomic offer and countless things To do. During your leisure time you can, shop at Paseo La Fe, Citadel Mall and Sendero Apodaca Mall. Corporate guests will find big spacious work stations at our lobby with free wireless internet access and a business corner where you can print, scan or make a last-minute check of your flight. All our contemporary and comfortable guest rooms are designed to provide you an efficient experience for business traveling, including ergonomic chair, Come and relax in a comfortable environment enjoying the most efficient and friendly service in the city, where you will also discover the unsurpassed benefits of our IHG Rewards Club program.

items.description: Monterrey Airport Hotel with Suites Stay at the Holiday Inn Express & Suites Monterrey Aeropuerto Hotel and get to Monterrey International Airport (MTY) in less than five minutes. We are also convenient to the northeastern industrial parks such as Milenium, Stiva Aeropuerto, Apodaca Technology Park, Finsa and Kalos Apodaca. Also, have easy access to the highways leading to nearby cities such as Saltillo, Cadereyta and Reynosa. During your leisure time, shop at Citadel Mall and choose from different restaurants and bars around the hotel to dine. After a day of travel or work, rest in a comfortable room or spacious suite, stay on top of your workout routine at the Fitness Center. Our other free-of-charge services are a shuttle service to the airport and other nearby locations, daily American buffet breakfast and high-speed internet access.

items.description: Located near the Monterrey International Airport (MTY). The Crowne Plaza® Monterrey Aeropuerto Hotel is conveniently located near the industrial zone and to several important companies in the city. This Monterrey hotel offers a free shuttle to and from places within 6 miles providing easy access to the airport (Consult with the Front desk availability), the Technological Innovation Park (PIIT) and the Technology Park Apodaca. Meeting rooms, Business Center and a convenient location make us the perfect place for those who travel for business. Enjoy our most spacious and comfortable rooms in the Apodaca area, specially equipped for the business and leisure traveler. The Gym is open without restrictions. Relax after a day of work in our Spa, Subject to reservation and enjoy our refreshing outdoor pool.
